required_protocol_amendments.budget_matching: Four candidate slots, four operator lookups, four verifier calls of eight examples and fixed construction units per target for every arm
required_protocol_amendments.grammar_scope: Use the frozen deterministic first-occurrence structural pool under the depth-3/node-7 grammar; full structural enumeration is not attempted and unsampled expressions are outside the evidence scope
required_protocol_amendments.operator_promotion: At most two eligible operators, 16 independent validation trials each, Beta(1,1) LCB95 >= 0.80; 16/16 required
required_protocol_amendments.statistical_dependence: Targets are unique across seeds; resample complete task-seed clusters within seed-by-family strata and never resample arm outcomes independently
required_protocol_amendments.statistics: Exact two-sided McNemar on task-seed pairs plus 20,000-replicate stratified task-cluster bootstrap confidence interval
required_protocol_amendments.target_denominator: 144 target tasks per seed, 72 per family, 288 paired task-seed units total
required_protocol_amendments.zero_promotion: If no operator reaches 16/16 and Beta(1,1) LCB95 >= 0.80, classify the mechanism as unactivated/inconclusive; do not interpret it as evidence against an active policy
